title: Problem 1.9 — (X.-S.
exact_target: Describe the complex zeros arising from Jones polynomials of all knots and of alternating knots, including their distribution and comparison with bounded-degree integer polynomials.

sources.citation: ULAM. AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 10400009 (AMR-103-0009). CC BY 4.0.

T. Ohtsuki (editor), \emph{Problems on invariants of knots and 3-manifolds}, Geometry \& Topology Monographs 4 (2002), pp. 377--572 (published 2004), item 1.9 and its surrounding definitions and remarks.
